- Healthcare AI vendor focused on clinical trial matching and radiology report summarization. Regulated data (PHI) — primary driver for Private (VPC) ask.

Timeline / recent activity:

Deployment & architecture notes: 
- Desired topology: customer VPC peered to Redwood-managed connector VPC (AWS Transit Gateway preferred). Prefer central egress at customer firewall; no direct public ingress to model nodes.
- Inbound/outbound: All inbound limited to TLS over private peering; control plane egress to Redwood API endpoints via NAT/proxy. Customer requires allow-listing of Redwood management IP ranges (will need to provide CIDR set).
- Regions: Primary in us-east-1, DR in us-west-2; data residency restricted to NA only. No EU/APAC replication.
- KMS: Customer uses AWS KMS with strict HSM-backed keys (customer-managed). Must support envelope encryption and bring-your-own-key (BYOK) workflow. Infosec wants evidence of handshake, key usage logs, and proof that Redwood can't access plaintext keys.
- Audit logging: Must provide per-request audit logs (tokenized), retention 7 years for compliance auditing, and immutable export to customer's S3 (w/ object lock).
- Networking specifics: Need support for egress proxies, mTLS for service-to-service, and support for customer-owned private endpoints for tracing hooks.
- Quantization & model notes: Prefer quantized LLM variants for cost but want quality baseline tests — Redwood Optimize recommended to run suite on clinical prompt set.

- Provide SOC2 + ISO27001 attestation copies (requested).
- Fill in KMS key lifecycle & rotation table in questionnaire (SEC-5910).
- Confirm ability to route audit logs to customer S3 with object lock and KMS encryption.
- Provide network CIDR ranges for dedicated connectors and expected ports.

Commercial / procurement: 
- Target ARR: $250k-$500k. Interested in 12–24 month reserved capacity for predictable throughput.
- Procurement timeline: internal budget cycle ends 2026-05; procurement requires SOW + security sign-off before PO.
